notes.title: New Game Special Announcement & Pricing
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27777811/ef33e1911b3834f4ca0e8505a4e227fead32dd40.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone!
I am very happy to announced that after a very long break, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784750/Sea_of_Tranquility/"][b]Sea of Tranquility[/b][/url], a new game is underway!
Sea of Tranquility is a sci-fi adventure with open world gameplay, optional quests, alternative endings and many other features. There may even be an easter-egg reference to ACOBM.

I hope you will check it out and consider adding it to your [b]Wishlist[/b].

[b]Special price announcement[/b]

A Collection of Bad Moments is not that long away from turning a decade old already![/p][p]To celebrate [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784750/Sea_of_Tranquility/"]Sea of Tranquility[/url], ACOBM will be available for [b]FREE[/b] for the Steam community soonish.

Thanks for everyone who played.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30750422/bc0108cb14183bbeacad537f1a467f6421a5ef39.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Free DLC - The Vault - Released!
notes.notes:
[h1]A free DLC which adds a new Moment to the game called The Vault has been released![/h1] 

It is automatically now included in the newest version of the English ACOBM build! ːvacdoorː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30750422/abc86444150f82e63d48d9edd3bb1008834d3489.jpg[/img]

In [b]The Vault[/b], the player is thrown to an underground safety vault from where they must figure a way to escape! The peculiarity of the vault is that its security system is designed to be manned by two personnel at all times and finding a way out it poses a new challenge for the player by having to escape it all alone. The Vault contains two distinct puzzles without time limits in a subterranean setting!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30750422/ce6aa6e8715aa8c24a67fd9650f6f9e27322fd1b.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30750422/54bb3e1bdec6023476c4fac834444c0695e9a34c.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30750422/b5dca4b363d0d540c089135f807553cfe0cb4321.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ACOBM Released!
notes.notes: ACOBM has been released today with a 10% launch discount. The game has text localisation for Finnish, Japanese and English! It is also available with a bundle with out previous scifi adventure Trajectory, at 20% discount!
